::: {.safety-box}
Use only teacher-prepared, reversible faults. Power off before moving wires or
components. Use voltage mode on energized circuits and resistance/continuity
only after isolation and discharge. None of these cards requires a deliberate
short circuit.
:::

::: {.fault-grid}
::: {.fault-card}
